scientific_integrity: Primary 1991 structural and 2008 semioval results credited. Exactly one new combined claim; no proof of worldwide publication priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-plane order-three classification only; general SRS theory and smallest maximal SRS structure were already established in 1991. Earlier unindexed enumeration remains a priority risk; finite exhaustive proofs rely on the embedded standalone implementations. Mengyán (2008) was compared at abstract level only because full-text access required additional human approval.
title: Induced-matching and saturation spectra of the order-three projective-plane Levi graph
